jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer / Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our engineering team to solve business problems and transform architectural concepts into production systems across our full technology stack.

You'll build and maintain in\-house platforms, infrastructure, integrations, APIs, Lambda functions, and both backend and frontend applications while ensuring governance and compliance standards. You'll also play an active role in raising the bar on engineering practices across the team.

**Key Requirements**

**Architecture \& Compliance**

* Proven ability to translate high\-level concepts into scalable technical implementations
* Experience implementing security controls and compliance requirements in production
* Understanding of authentication, authorization, encryption, and audit logging
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks and regulatory requirements
* Experience with system integration and event\-driven architectures

**Technical Capabilities**

* 5\+ years full\-stack software engineering experience
* Strong proficiency in backend technologies (C\#, Java, Node.js or similar)
* Strong proficiency in frontend frameworks and libraries (React, Vue, jQuery, CSS or similar)
* Strong proficiency in IaC (Terraform, etc.) on AWS
* Strong proficiency in CI/CD pipelines with GitLab
* Hands\-on experience in AWS with experience in EC2/RDS and other serverless workloads.
* Experience with IIS, Apache Server or similar web server technologies
* Experience with SQL databases
* Understanding of RESTful API design and microservices architecture

**Work Environment**

You will be working in a complex ministry environment characterized by:

* Multiple ongoing business policy initiatives and modernization initiatives alongside legacy system maintenance
* Diverse technology stack including OutSystems, C\#, Java, Node.js and cloud infrastructure (GCC/AWS)
* Government security and compliance requirements that shape technical decisions
* Resource constraints requiring pragmatic approaches that balance immediate needs with long\-term sustainability

*This role is ideal for someone who wants to make a lasting impact beyond just delivering code. You'll build systems that matter while establishing the technical foundation for future ministry initiatives.*

Pay: $6,000\.00 \- $8,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Stage Centraal Feedback Platform
jobs.description:
Wil jij impact maken op IT-dienstverlening en leren hoe je feedback structureert en benut? Bij a.s.r. werk je aan een slimme aanpak voor het verzamelen en verbeteren van feedback. Binnen a.s.r. werken we continu aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening richting interne IT-gebruikers. Daarbij is feedback van gebruikers essentieel. Denk aan developers, architecten en andere teams die dagelijks gebruikmaken van platformdiensten.
Op dit moment komt feedback via verschillende kanalen binnen, waardoor overzicht en prioritering lastig zijn. Daarom starten we met Azure als concrete eerste casus: een veelgebruikt platform met een duidelijke en urgente behoefte aan betere feedbackstructurering.

Het doel van deze stage gaat echter verder dan alleen Azure. We willen een aanpak ontwikkelen die herbruikbaar is voor bredere IT-dienstverlening binnen de organisatie. Azure fungeert hierbij als startpunt om te leren, te testen en te verbeteren.Tijdens deze stage onderzoek jij hoe we feedback slimmer kunnen organiseren. Eerst voor Azure, maar met het oog op schaalbaarheid naar andere diensten

Dit ga je doen tijdens je Stage Centraal Feedback Platform bij a.s.r.
Je onderzoekt hoe feedback op Azure én vergelijkbare diensten nu wordt verzameld en verwerkt
Je haalt behoeften op bij gebruikers en stakeholders, met aandacht voor bredere toepasbaarheid
Je verkent bestaande oplossingen die generiek inzetbaar zijn
Je bepaalt welke oplossing(en) het beste passen bij a.s.r., zowel voor Azure als voor bredere dienstverlening

Dit bieden we je
een vergoeding van €500 op basis van 5 dagen per week
goede begeleiding door een ervaren collega en ruimte om je talentent te ontdekken en je verder te ontwikkelen, zodat jouw stage niet alleen maar voelt als werk
ruimte om je talenten te ontdekken en verder te ontwikkelen, zodat jouw stage niet alleen maar voelt als werk
hybride werken, op kantoor en vanuit huis en ruimte om je eigen werktijden te bepalen
werkervaring opdoen bij een organisatie die duurzame impact wil maken; samen stropen we onze mouwen op voor een eerlijkere en duurzamere toekomst

Deze stage is echt iets voor jou, want jij
Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding (bijv. IT, Business IT & Management of Computer Science)
Je hebt interesse in cloud, tooling en gebruikerservaring
Je vindt het leuk om oplossingen te analyseren én praktisch toe te passen
Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt graag vragen

Dit ga je doen tijdens je Stage Centraal Feedback Platform in Utrecht
Je loopt stage binnen het Azure Solution Delivery team van a.s.r.
Dit team werkt aan het fundament van onze cloudomgeving: van governance en security tot automation en developer experience. Je werkt samen met engineers, architects en product owners.

Joey van den Heuvel (Product Owner): 0610450508 / joey.van.den.heuvel@asr.nl.

jobs.title: Product Engineer - M365 Unified Collaboration & Gen AI
jobs.description:
Join us at Barclays as a Product Engineer - M365 Unified Collaboration & Gen AI, where you will play a key role in the design, build, and support of collaboration, productivity, automation, and AI-enabled solutions across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on delivering high-quality solutions that enhance colleague experience and drive business value.

Working as part of a collaborative engineering team, you will be responsible for developing, configuring, and implementing M365 and AI solutions, translating business requirements into scalable technical outcomes, and supporting the adoption of new capabilities. You will contribute to solution design, troubleshooting, platform optimisation, and continuous improvement initiatives, while ensuring solutions are secure, resilient, and aligned to Barclays engineering standards. The successful candidate will be passionate about emerging technologies, have a delivery mindset, and enjoy working closely with stakeholders and peers to solve complex business challenges.

To be successful as a Product Engineer - M365, you must have the following essential skills:

Copilot, AI Agents & Power Platform Engineering - Hands-on experience designing and delivering M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI agents, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and enterprise automation solutions.
M365 Platform Expertise - Strong knowledge of Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, M365 Groups, and Entra ID, including integration and authentication.
Security, Identity & Enterprise Controls - Experience implementing RBAC, DLP, environment management, governance controls, and secure operating models aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

Microsoft Graph, PowerShell & Automation - Experience developing automation, integrations, and operational tooling using Microsoft Graph APIs, PowerShell, REST APIs, and scripting languages.
Azure & Enterprise Integration - Experience designing and supporting integrations using Azure services and connecting Microsoft 365 solutions with enterprise and external platforms.
Engineering Tooling & DevOps - Experience using GitHub/GitLab, Visual Studio, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, source control, and DevOps practices to support scalable and repeatable solution delivery.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based in Knutsford.

Purpose of the role

To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

Accountabilities

Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

Assistant Vice President Expectations

To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer (202609)
jobs.description:
Digify is a cloud-based document security and data room platform used by over 800,000 professionals across 138 countries to protect sensitive documents and control how they are accessed, shared, and tracked.

We're building the next generation of secure document infrastructure across browsers, cloud storage, email, web, and mobile platforms — helping organizations maintain control over sensitive information after it leaves their hands.

Our engineering team works on systems involving:

secure document delivery and viewing
authentication and access control
encryption and file handling
browser and cloud integrations
scalable backend services and analytics

We're looking for an engineer who has strong software engineering fundamentals, enjoys building real-world production systems, and is adaptable to evolving development workflows, including AI-assisted and agentic coding tools.

What You'll Be Doing

Design, build, and maintain features across our document security platform
Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and other engineers throughout the development lifecycle.
Work across backend and frontend systems, with opportunities to contribute to browser integrations and mobile-related functionality
Develop systems related to authentication, access control, file delivery, and secure document handling
Contribute to APIs, integrations, background workers, and analytics pipelines
Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to ship reliable, maintainable software
Debug and resolve production issues and technical problems.

Requirements

Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
3-6 years of software engineering experience, including experience working on production systems
Strong fundamentals in software engineering, algorithms, and system design
Experience with TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks
Experience with .Net Framework and C#
Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, etc.)
Comfortable contributing across both frontend and backend systems, while being stronger in one area
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and technical judgment
Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
Comfortable working in evolving product and technical environments with changing requirements and priorities
Openness to modern development workflows, including AI-assisted and agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.)

Nice-to-have:

Experience with security, encryption, authentication, or access control systems
Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, or event-driven architectures
Experience with browser extensions, mobile apps, or file-heavy systems
Experience integrating with third-party APIs and cloud platforms (Google, AWS, etc.)
Experience with automated testing and modern software development practices.

Why Join Digify:

Work on technically challenging security and file-platform problems
Be part of an experienced and collaborative engineering team
Build products used by organizations around the world
Take ownership of meaningful systems and product areas

jobs.title: Senior Requirements Engineer Digital Product, 80-100%
jobs.description:
PEAX bietet eine Lösung für automatisierten Dokumenteneingang, intelligentes Document Processing und Weiterverarbeitung in nachgelagerten Geschäftsprozessen. Damit werden unsere Kunden von administrativem Aufwand befreit und erkennen den Wert ihrer Daten. Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Produktentwicklung mit analytischer Tiefe und einem ausgeprägten AI-First-Mindset auf das nächste Level bringen.

Aufgaben
Das bewegst du

Du verantwortest das fachliche Herz unseres Produkts: das Domänenmodell. Capabilities, Business Objects, Business Rules und Prozesse hältst du korrekt, widerspruchsfrei und aktuell. Und du sorgst dafür, dass sie über Domänen hinweg zusammenpassen.

Aus vielschichtigen, oft widersprüchlichen Anforderungen machst du klare Struktur: Nachvollziehbare Use Cases, scharf geschnittene Anforderungen und eindeutige Akzeptanzkriterien. Dein wichtigster Beitrag ist dabei nicht, jeden Einzelwunsch zu spezifizieren. Es ist zu erkennen, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und die allgemeine Lösung durchzusetzen.

Du präzisierst Produktentscheide für die Umsetzung: Regeln, Grenzfälle, Zustände und Sollverhalten. Bei komplexen und domänenübergreifenden Themen führst du die Spezifikation selbst. Im Übrigen setzt du den Standard, nach dem im Team spezifiziert wird, und entwickelst die Modellierungskompetenz deiner Kolleg:innen weiter.

Qualität ist für dich Teil der Spezifikationsarbeit und kein nachgelagerter Schritt. Du erstellst E2E-Testkonzepte und Testfälle für deinen Bereich und prüfst Features. Wir sind ein kleines Team, in dem alle die Qualität des Produkts mittragen.

Du bist für die von dir verantworteten Features die fachliche Ansprechperson für Engineering, Design, Customer Success und Sales sowie für Partner, Reseller und Kunden. Du bist auch die Person, die „so geht das fachlich nicht“ sagen kann und dafür gehört wird.

Deine Arbeit startet in der Product Discovery: Bei der Problemrahmung, nicht erst bei der Übersetzung fertiger Entscheide. Zudem bringst du deine fachliche Sicht in Architekturentscheide ein, wo sie Konsequenzen für das Domänenmodell haben.

PEAX baut gerade agentische Architekturen. Du nutzt AI-Tools strukturiert und verantwortungsvoll als Bestandteil unseres Requirement Engineering Prozesses.

Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit

Mehrjährige Senior-Erfahrung als Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im B2B-SaaS-Produktumfeld, idealerweise in einer Scale-up-Phase und mit Hintergrund in Document Management, ECM, Workflow-Automatisierung oder einem verwandten Information-Hub-Umfeld. Du hast dabei nachweisbar Verantwortung für fachliche Modelle getragen und nicht nur für Spezifikationsdokumente.

Ausbildungshintergrund in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Business Engineering, BWL mit IT-Affinität (FH, Universität). MSc-Niveau ideal, Bachelor mit entsprechender Senior-Erfahrung ebenfalls möglich.

Echte Modellierungstiefe: Du kannst ein Geschäftsproblem in Entitäten, Zustände, Regeln und Prozesse zerlegen, so dass das Ergebnis widerspruchsfrei ist. Du formulierst Akzeptanzkriterien so, dass sie prüfbar sind. Sicherer Umgang mit BPMN, UML, Use Cases und User Stories sowie mit Jira und Confluence. Kenntnisse in ArchiMate sind ein Pluspunkt.

Generalisierungsinstinkt: Du erkennst, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und setzt die allgemeine Lösung durch. Du fragst nach dem Problem, bevor du nach der Lösung fragst, und du kannst eine Anforderung auch ablehnen.

Eingehendes Verständnis für administrative Prozesse in KMU, die Aufbereitung von Daten und zur Verfügungstellung via Schnittstellen an Drittanwendungen. Damit zusammenhängend die Fähigkeit, Problemstellen in bestehenden Prozessen zu analysieren und durch intelligente Abläufe zu ersetzen.

Hohe Affinität zu AI-Tools, idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter Spezifikationsarbeit, Prompt Engineering oder agentischen Systemen aus Produkt-Sicht.

Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher (C1). Sicheres Auftreten auf C-Level.

Benefits
Wir bieten dir

Faire Spesenregelung

Förderung und Unterstützung zur Weiterentwicklung und Weiterbildung

PEAX Private Abo

Flache Hierarchien, agile Arbeitsweise

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice; Standort in Luzern (Hybrid)

Tolles Office und Begegnungsort inmitten der Stadt Luzern

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!
